rationale: Rick is building Pangian, a global remote talent platform powered by AI/ML to match professionals across borders, while Ben is a fullstack developer actively shipping AI and computer vision projects—making him exactly the type of early-stage builder Rick mentors at Techstars. Both are based in San Francisco and Rick's conviction that AI/ML will be central to matching talent with opportunity at scale directly aligns with Ben's hands-on experience building AI applications, offering concrete mentorship potential on product direction and startup growth.
intro_message: Rick Uzcategui, meet Ben Nisevich — Rick built Pangian, an AI-powered remote talent platform, and actively mentors early-stage developers like you; Ben's shipping AI and computer vision projects and could benefit from Rick's expertise in scaling talent-matching technology.
